scope: Fifteen distinct visual presentation recipes over one shared portfolio view model and data source.

test_evidence.basis: Coordinator-reported aggregate of 41/41 modified tests passed; this reporting task did not rerun them.
test_evidence.focused_registry_tests: tests/design-registry.test.js verifies all 15 unique registrations, required metadata/renderers, distinct hero markup, exactly one h1, portrait/source-content retention, escaped hostile synthetic content, and duplicate/malformed/incomplete rejection.

real_responsive_evidence.summary_method: Counted the 5 arrays × 15 design rows in responsive-evidence.json. Each row had scrollWidth equal to its measured width and nameOverflow zero. For the 305px and larger width rows, the evidence contains width, scrollWidth, photoWidth, and nameOverflow fields; the 375px and 1425px arrays also record 11 sections, and the 1425px array records one h1, loaded portrait dimension, 87 project records, theme and hero height.

retained_shared_capabilities.shared_normalized_view_model: Registry renderers consume shared source-backed model/helpers rather than cloning or inventing project/experience records.
retained_shared_capabilities.portrait_and_identity: Each focused registry test renders the supplied synthetic portrait and identity; real responsive evidence reports portrait dimensions.
retained_shared_capabilities.sections: All designs register renderers for hero, about, projects, and experience; real evidence reports 11 page sections for the measured full-page cases.
retained_shared_capabilities.project_records_and_controls: Shared renderer provides project search, topic filter, card actions, project modal trigger, optional source link, and empty state; registry tests verify project sections render, not every control in every design in a real browser.
retained_shared_capabilities.source_integrity_and_security: Source strings are escaped. Tests verify hostile synthetic markup is not emitted as active HTML. Source-derived counts/categories are labels, not fabricated proficiency measurements.
retained_shared_capabilities.themes_and_background: Design metadata supplies default themes and the wider portfolio/studio manages theme/background preferences; this evidence set does not independently verify every theme/background × design combination.
retained_shared_capabilities.other_portfolio_features: This responsive evidence does not prove real-browser operation of README, certificates, skills, search, project modal, or every interaction in all 15 designs; retain the existing shared implementations and rely on their separate tests/evidence.

publication.note: Local responsive evidence and reported test pass do not establish publication or production verification.

limitations: The supplied responsive evidence is a private artifact and remains outside public Git.
The 75 responsive rows evidence layout widths and name overflow only; it does not establish all interactions, accessibility, browser/device combinations, or production behavior.
Measured width is the available layout/client width (305, 375, 753, 1009, 1425px), corresponding to the five nominal viewport classes supplied by the coordinator (320, 390, 768, 1024, 1440px).
No publication/deployment has occurred for this collection.
